approval_basis.scope: Pinned natural Math L2-preview only; Code and L3 remain under review

rationale: The owner explicitly accepts the declared dataset terms and missing original URL/parent identifiers as disclosed limitations under the existing guarded-use policy.
attribution_plan: Cite UltraData-Math and its tiered-data paper; retain dataset revision, shard/row, content hashes and available quality labels; disclose missing original-document URLs and ancestry.
redistribution_policy: Publish metadata, statistics, citations and required notices; do not redistribute source text or packed shards. Public model weights follow the existing Apache-2.0 release policy.
removal_policy: Retain dataset/revision/shard/row and content-hash identities for exclusion and rebuilds. Original URL/domain-only ancestry is unavailable without upstream mapping; disclose that limitation rather than claiming complete URL-based removal coverage.
conditions: Apply qualified English filtering and benchmark contamination checks before training-view preparation.
Apply complete firewall-reference precedence plus global exact and verified-near exclusion before training.
Preserve original content and quality_label metadata; any additional quality cutoff is a separate recipe decision.
Re-review material source-term changes or an explicit training/public-weight prohibition.
This source-use decision does not select D5, approve Code or L3, or authorize a model-training launch.
